# Plain Sums

> Free UK tax and money calculators for trades, small firms and executors, plus paid spreadsheet templates sold on Gumroad. Calculators run in the browser and cite GOV.UK. Estimates, not tax or legal advice. Not affiliated with HMRC. Made by Arthur Jones.

## Home

- [Plain Sums](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/): Home page, with the CIS calculators first.

## Calculators

- [Calculators](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/): Index of the free calculators.
- [CIS tax refund estimator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/cis-refund-estimator/): For subcontractors. Estimate your CIS refund or tax bill for 2025/26 or 2026/27, and see which Self Assessment boxes the figures go in.
- [CIS deduction calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/cis-deduction-calculator/): For contractors and subcontractors. Check what should come off an invoice at 20%, 30% or gross: labour only, with materials and VAT left out.
- [Probate and Inheritance Tax calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/probate-iht-calculator/): For England and Wales. Estimate the Inheritance Tax on an estate, with the residence allowance, gifts and the probate fee.
- [Late payment interest calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/late-payment-interest-calculator/): For businesses chasing a late invoice. Work out the statutory interest at 8% plus base rate, and the £40, £70 or £100 compensation.
- [HMRC late payment interest calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/hmrc-late-payment-interest-calculator/): Estimate the interest HMRC charges on tax paid late, or pays on a repayment, day by day across rate changes. Includes 8% late payment interest and 3% repayment interest from 24 November 2026. An estimate, not tax advice.
- [Gift Inheritance Tax taper checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/gift-iht-taper-checker/): For anyone who has given money away. See how far a gift is through the 7 years, its taper rate, and the day it drops out of Inheritance Tax.
- [VAT threshold checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/vat-threshold-checker/): For sole traders and small firms. Enter 12 months of sales and see your rolling total against £90,000, your headroom and any deadline to register.
- [Window cleaning price rise calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/window-cleaning-price-rise-calculator/): For window cleaners. See the new price per clean, what a rise adds over a year, and how many customers you could lose and still take the same.
- [Stretched funded hours calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/stretched-funded-hours-calculator/): For childminders and parents in England. Stretch 570 or 1,140 funded hours over the weeks a setting is open: hours a week, hours to claim per funded term week, and paid hours.
- [Did my allotment pay its way?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/allotment-pay-its-way-calculator/): For allotment holders. Enter what you picked and what you spent, set your own prices, and see if the plot paid its way this season.
- [Christmas Collection Slot Planner](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/christmas-collection-slot-planner/): For butchers, farm shops and bakers. Work out how many Christmas orders you can hand over in each collection slot, day by day, and whether your days and hours are enough.
- [Making Tax Digital checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/mtd-income-tax-checker/): For sole traders and landlords. Add self employment turnover and property income before expenses and see if Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies from 6 April 2026 (over £50,000), 2027 (over £30,000) or 2028 (over £20,000).
- [Making Tax Digital questions](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/mtd/): Short answers to common MTD for Income Tax questions, checked against GOV.UK. A guide, not advice.
- [Do I need MTD for Income Tax if I earn under £50,000?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/mtd/under-50k/): The £30,000 threshold from 6 April 2027 and £20,000 from 6 April 2028, and what counts as qualifying income.
- [What is an MTD quarterly update?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/mtd/quarterly-update/): A summary, not a tax return. Deadlines of 7 August, 7 November, 7 February and 7 May, and no penalty points for late updates in 2026 to 2027.
- [MTD for landlords with jointly owned property](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/mtd/joint-property/): Only your share counts towards qualifying income, and you can leave joint expenses out of quarterly updates.
- [What software do I need for MTD?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/mtd/software/): HMRC recognised software, including bridging software that connects to spreadsheets.
- [Take home pay calculator 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/take-home-pay-calculator/): For employees. Take home pay for 2026/27 after Income Tax (including Scotland), National Insurance, student loan Plans 1, 2, 4 and 5, Postgraduate Loan, and salary sacrifice or relief at source pensions.
- [Family business handover tax comparison](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/family-business-handover-tax-comparison/): A reported proposal, not law, as at 20 October 2026. Compare 24% Capital Gains Tax with 45% Income Tax on the value of a family business handed to the next generation.
- [What's my minimum wage pay rise worth?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/minimum-wage-rise-calculator/): For workers on the minimum wage. Compare pay at the current and April 2027 rates by age band and hours, before and after 2026/27 tax and National Insurance.
- [Can I live on this wage?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/can-i-live-on-this-wage/): Enter an hourly rate and hours to see 2026/27 take home pay, then add rent, bills and food for a monthly surplus or shortfall.
- [Is my pay rise beating inflation?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/pay-rise-vs-inflation-calculator/): Enter your old and new pay and see the real terms change against 3.5% CPI, with the amount needed to keep up.
- [EV pay per mile calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/ev-pay-per-mile-calculator/): For electric and plug in hybrid drivers. Estimate the 3p and 1.5p a mile charge from April 2028, confirmed at Budget 2026, and compare it with petrol Fuel Duty.
- [Pension Tax Allowance checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/state-pension-tax-calculator/): Check the new Pension Tax Allowance from April 2027. Put in your income by source and see your tax with and without the allowance, your marginal rate and what an extra £100 of pension really leaves you.
- [Mileage allowance and tax relief calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/mileage-allowance-tax-relief-calculator/): Work out the tax free mileage allowance for cars, vans, motorbikes and bikes, any taxable excess, and Mileage Allowance Relief when your employer pays less. Includes self employed simplified expenses.
- [Gas standing charge scrapped: will I save or pay more?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/gas-standing-charge-calculator/): Gas standing charges are due to be scrapped from 2027. Put in your gas use and see if folding the standing charge into the unit rate saves you money or costs you more.
- [Savings interest tax calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/savings-interest-tax-calculator/): Estimate the tax on your savings interest in 2026 to 2027 and from April 2027, when Budget 2026 raises savings rates to 24%, 44% and 49%, and see what an ISA could save.
- [£100 Household Energy Payment checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/household-energy-payment-checker/): Check if your home gets the £100 Household Energy Payment from January 2027 announced in Budget 2026: England, council tax bands A to D.
- [First Time Buyer ISA vs Lifetime ISA](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/first-time-buyer-isa-vs-lifetime-isa/): Compare the new First Time Buyer ISA from April 2029 with the Lifetime ISA: 25% bonus, £4,000 a year, £450,000 home cap, £20,000 bonus cap and the new 20% charge.
- [Landlord property income tax calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/landlord-property-income-tax-calculator/): Estimate income tax on your rental profit in 2026 to 2027 and from April 2027, when Budget 2026 sets property rates of 24%, 44% and 49%.
- [Self Assessment timely payments planner](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/self-assessment-timely-payments-planner/): Plan your cashflow for the Self Assessment timely payments change from April 2029. Compare today's 31 January and 31 July payments with monthly and quarterly in-year payments and see the extra cash needed in the 2029/30 transition year.
- [Business Asset Disposal Relief: sell before or after 6 April 2027?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/business-asset-disposal-relief-calculator/): Compare the Capital Gains Tax on a business sale under the £1 million Business Asset Disposal Relief limit and the £500,000 limit from 6 April 2027.
- [Capital allowances: how much can I claim in year one?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/capital-allowances-first-year-calculator/): Estimate your first year capital allowances on plant and machinery after Budget 2026: the 12% writing down allowance, the 50% first year allowance, the £1 million AIA and full expensing.
- [Do I need to tell HMRC about my side hustle?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/side-hustle-trading-allowance-checker/): Check if your side income is covered by the trading allowance, £1,000 in 2026 to 2027 and £3,000 from 6 April 2027, and whether the allowance or your costs gives the lower profit.
- [Self Assessment payments on account calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/self-assessment-payments-on-account-calculator/): Work out your 31 January balancing payment and payments on account, whether the £1,000 and 80% rules mean you pay none, and what reducing them would do.
- [Self Assessment late penalty calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/self-assessment-late-penalty-calculator/): Estimate late filing penalties, late payment penalties and late payment interest if a Self Assessment return or the 31 January tax is late. The 2025 to 2026 return is the default. An estimate, not tax advice.
- [Marriage Allowance checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/marriage-allowance-checker/): Check if you can move £1,260 of Personal Allowance to your spouse or civil partner, the saving of up to £252 a year, and backdating to 2022/23.
- [Side hustle tax calculator](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/side-hustle-tax-calculator/): The Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance on side hustle profit on top of your salary, with the £1,000 allowance or your costs, for 2025/26 and 2026/27.
- [Christmas budget planner](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/christmas-budget-planner/): Add up gifts, food, drink, travel and nights out, compare with your budget and see what to put aside each week until 25 December.
- [Boxing Day sale discount checker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/boxing-day-sale-discount-checker/): Work out % off, was and now prices and multi buy deals, and check whether a sale price is a real saving.
- [Small business rate relief for shops, cafés and pubs](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/retail-hospitality-leisure-rate-relief-checker/): Check the small business rate relief for a shop, café, pub or other retail, hospitality or leisure property in England, now and from 1 April 2027 when the 100% threshold rises to £18,000.
- [What does it really cost to employ someone?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/employer-cost-calculator/): Work out what it really costs to employ someone in the UK: wage, employer National Insurance at 15% above £5,000, a 3% auto enrolment pension and Employment Allowance, now and from April 2027.
- [How much more will I repay while the Plan 2 threshold is frozen?](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/tools/plan-2-student-loan-freeze-calculator/): See how much more you repay on a Plan 2 student loan while the £29,385 threshold is frozen from April 2027 to April 2030, compared with a threshold that rises with RPI.
- [Budget 2026 hub](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/budget-2026/): What the 28 October 2026 Budget changes for pay, pensions, savings and business, with links to every Budget calculator.

## Templates

- [Templates](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/): Paid spreadsheet templates for UK tax and money records, sold on Gumroad.
- [UK CIS Subcontractor Self Assessment Tracker 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/cis-subcontractor-tracker/): £14.99. For subcontractors. Log what you are paid, the CIS taken off, expenses and mileage, and see an estimate of your refund or tax bill.
- [UK CIS Contractor Monthly Return Tracker 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/cis-contractor-tracker/): £14.99. For contractors. Subcontractors, verifications, deductions on labour only, monthly return totals and deduction statements.
- [UK CIS Mileage and Expenses Log Lite 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/cis-mileage-lite/): Free, pay what you want (£0+). Log every business mile and receipt, with totals ready for Self Assessment.
- [Both Sides of CIS Bundle 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/cis-bundle/): £21.99. The subcontractor tracker, the contractor tracker and the free mileage log together. £29.98 bought separately.
- [UK Executor and Probate Tracker 2026/27 (England and Wales)](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/probate-tracker/): £19.99. For executors in England and Wales. Tasks, assets, an IHT estimate, the estate ledger and accounts for beneficiaries.
- [UK Gifts and Inheritance Tax 7 Year Tracker](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/gifts-iht-tracker/): £12.99. Keep a record of gifts as you make them, with exemptions, the 7 year clock and the taper.
- [UK Freelancer Time, Invoice and Late Payment Tracker 2026/27](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/freelancer-late-payment-tracker/): £14.99. Time, invoices and who has not paid in one place, with statutory late payment interest worked out.
- [UK Small Business Sales Dashboard and VAT Threshold Watch](https://e13ctr0n1c.github.io/templates/sales-dashboard-vat-watch/): £12.99. Sales, margin and targets, plus the rolling 12 month figure HMRC tests against the £90,000 VAT threshold.
